text: i fall thru the heightfield of the walls. not the floor of the pool. just the edge. and its heightfields in other places also. + need to add a slope tool for water to be able to do a proper ocean
resolution: Two follow-ups for the bodies-of-water feature. TASK 1 (heightfield edge fall-through): the player fell through the steep dug WALLS of a painted water basin (and any heightfield edge) — not the flat floor. Root cause was in framework/game/physics.zig: ground support sampled only WALKABLE heightfield cells (normal_y >= walk_cos), so a steep face returned NO support and dropped you into the void; the code comment already described the intended 'stand on it, no fall-through' behavior but it was never implemented. Split the concern — new heightfieldFloorAt stands you on the highest mesh surface at/below the feet regardless of slope, while the slope LIMIT (can you climb) stays enforced by the existing move-cancel wall-block + walkable-only query for speed clamping. Fixes editor /test and compiled (same physics.step). TASK 2 (water slope tool): added a 'waterSlope' height-mode ('shore' in the terrain rail) reusing the slope-stroke machinery to dig a graded shore→deep basin and fill water flush, for a wadeable ocean shoreline instead of a flat-walled pit; floorToWaterBody handles the graded bed with no model change, 6/6 water tests pass.
